messages.subject: Corporate Affairs Executive | Government Relations, ESG & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Taylor Birchwood Team,

Your senior search work across corporate affairs, communications and strategic leadership aligns closely with my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where reputation, policy, stakeholder engagement and responsible growth intersect. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
